rework_lineage.rework_reason: T030-R1 found AC-CTX-1 not satisfied: the canonical baseline baked git rev-parse HEAD into a top-level field, so regenerating the baseline after the finalization commit that persists the baseline/handoff changed the recorded revision without any change in measured tracked content.
rework_lineage.rework_design: Honest provenance/finalization contract: tools/repository_context.py now exposes VOLATILE_EXECUTION_METADATA_KEY containing source_git_revision, declared explicitly as not part of canonical baseline identity; canonical_payload(), canonical_identity_digest(), and validate_canonical_identity() form the canonical identity API; tracked_content_digest remains the deterministic content identity.

implementation_summary: Bounded T030-R1 rework correcting AC-CTX-1. The source-only measurement tool now separates volatile execution metadata (source_git_revision) from the canonical baseline payload. Two new public helpers — canonical_payload() and canonical_identity_digest() — plus validate_canonical_identity() form the canonical identity API; tracked_content_digest remains the deterministic tracked-content identity. A new regression test (test_canonical_identity_survives_finalization_boundary) creates a real Git fixture, writes and commits the canonical baseline, advances HEAD with a metadata-only finalization commit, regenerates, and asserts canonical identity is identical across the HEAD advance while volatile metadata legitimately differs. The committed canonical baseline and this handoff sit in the working tree awaiting parent finalization.

architecture.source_boundary: tools/repository_context.py is outside src/agent_governance, governance-core, governance-skill, and the explicit T020 Consumer artifact inputs.
architecture.inventory: git ls-files --cached selects tracked paths; the tool reads current worktree bytes, handles symlinks and non-UTF-8/binary content deterministically, and excludes the DEFAULT_BASELINE path plus any caller-provided excluded_paths so committing the baseline/handoff cannot perturb the measured tracked tree.
architecture.determinism: Sorted paths and edges plus compact sort-key JSON produce byte-identical canonical payload for unchanged tracked content. The committed canonical baseline can be regenerated at the finalization commit (or any later HEAD that only differs by a metadata-only finalization commit) without byte drift caused solely by persisting the baseline/handoff.
architecture.provenance_semantics: VOLATILE_EXECUTION_METADATA_KEY holds source_git_revision, explicitly documented as per-execution provenance and NOT part of canonical baseline identity. TRACKED_CONTENT_DIGEST_KEY is derived from the ordered (path, sha256) identities of measured tracked files only; it survives the finalization boundary because the baseline file is excluded from measurement.
architecture.canonical_identity_api: canonical_payload(report) returns the canonical portion of a report; canonical_identity_digest(report) returns its SHA-256; validate_canonical_identity(*reports) raises MeasurementError if any two reports differ in canonical payload.
architecture.measurement_semantics: Raw bytes are canonical. Character, line, and Markdown heading counts exist only for UTF-8 text. Static resolvable local Markdown links and code-span paths are structural graph evidence only and are explicitly not observed RFO, TMC, CAR, token counts, or runtime loads.
architecture.enforcement: Measure-only operation has no size budget, warning threshold, split/refactor behavior, document mutation, network access, or Consumer runtime effect.
